name: Dora the Explorer
description: A young girl named Dora goes on adventures with her red boot-wearing monkey named Boots.

videos.title: The Big Red Chicken
videos.overview: Dora reads the story of  "The Legend of the Big Red Chicken".

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: Dora and Boots must reunite a baby blue bird with its mother.

videos.title: Choo Choo
videos.overview: Dora and Boots help Azul, the train, to win a race.

videos.title: Hic-Boom-Ohhh
videos.overview: Dora and Boots investigate a strange sound.

videos.title: We All Scream for Ice Cream
videos.overview: Dora and Boots race off to intercept the ice cream truck.

videos.title: Three Little Piggies
videos.overview: Dora and Boots must find three little piggies and give them their presents before Swiper swipes the gifts.

videos.title: Treasure Island
videos.overview: Dora and Boots find a key to a treasure chest, and with Pirate Parrot's help, they search for the treasure chest.

videos.title: Beaches
videos.overview: Dora gives Boots a floaty to help him swim, and the two head off to the beach.

videos.title: Big River
videos.overview: Boots loses his boot in the river. Together with Dora, they must pursue the boot before it reaches the waterfall.

videos.title: Wizzle Wishes
videos.overview: Dora and Boots help a Wizzle recover his lost wishes.

videos.title: Berry Hunt
videos.overview: Dora and Boots hunt for blueberries on Blueberry Hill -- home of Swiper the Fox.

videos.title: Surprise
videos.overview: It's Boots' birthday and the party is at Dora's house.

videos.title: Grandma's House
videos.overview: Dora and Boots endeavour to bring a basket of treats to Abuela.

videos.title: Sticky Tape
videos.overview: Benny the Bull needs sticky tape to repair a hole in his hot air balloon.

videos.title: Bouncing Ball
videos.overview: Boots chases after his new, super bouncy ball.

videos.title: Bugga Bugga
videos.overview: Dora and Boots help Mama Bugga Bugga get home with a cookie to feed her babies.

videos.title: Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: Dora and Boots help a baby fish, trapped in a tide pool, get home.

videos.title: El Coqui
videos.overview: Dora and Boots find a frog who has lost its voice.

videos.title: The Chocolate Tree
videos.overview: Dora and Boots seek the Chocolate Tree and a gift for Abuela.

videos.title: To the Treehouse
videos.overview: Dora and Boots help their friends get to the treehouse for a party.

videos.title: Little Star
videos.overview: Dora and Boots help a fallen star get home to the Moon.

videos.title: Call Me Mr. Riddles
videos.overview: Boots is confident he can solve the Grumpy Old Troll's silliest riddles.

videos.title: Te Amo
videos.overview: El Mago has turned King Popo and Queen María into mountains, and Dora and Boots set out to break the spell.

videos.title: Pablo's Flute
videos.overview: Dora and Boots set off to return Pablo's magical flute and reverse a devastating drought.

videos.title: Dora Saves the Prince
videos.overview: Dora and Boots enter a storybook to rescue a prince, banished to a high tower by an evil witch.

videos.title: Lost Squeaky
videos.overview: Dora and Boots head to the Gooey Geyser to rescue Boots' lost squeaky bath toy.

videos.title: The Missing Piece
videos.overview: Dora and Boots help the jigsaw puzzle wizard, El Encantador, find his missing magic wand.

videos.title: Backpack
videos.overview: Dora recalls when she first met Backpack.

videos.title: The Big Storm
videos.overview: Dora and Boots must retrieve a toy fire truck from the top of Snowy Mountain.

videos.title: The Magic Stick
videos.overview: Dora and Boots find a magic stick.

videos.title: Rojo, the Fire Truck
videos.overview: Dora and Boots join Rojo, the red firetruck, on his first mission to save a little kitten stuck in a tree.

videos.title: El Dia De Las Madres (Mother's Day)
videos.overview: Dora and her friends form a soccer team.

videos.title: The Golden Explorers
videos.overview: Dora and her friends form a soccer team and play against the big dinosaurs.

videos.title: Doctor Dora
videos.overview: Dora and Boots, along with their trusty friends Backpack and Map, need to help Benny, who is sick.

videos.title: Pinto, the Pony Express
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are a cowboy and cowgirl who ride their trusty friend Pinto the Pony across the Wild West to deliver cowboy-shaped cookies to Benny.

videos.title: The Big Piñata
videos.overview: Dora and Boots need to collect 10 yellow tickets at the carnival to win the big prize: a Big Pinata that contains a surprise.

videos.title: The Happy Old Troll
videos.overview: Dora and Boots try to find all the things that make Grumpy Old Troll not so grumpy.

videos.title: A Letter for Swiper
videos.overview: Dora tries to climb all the way across the monkey bars.

videos.title: Click
videos.overview: With her new camera, Dora and Boots snap photos for a contest.

videos.title: ¡Rápído, Tico! (Fast, Tico!)
videos.overview: Boots' toy fire truck gets missing on the top of Snowy Mountain, so Dora, Boots, and Tico have to retrieve it before Swiper does.

videos.title: A Present for Santa
videos.overview: Today is Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots head to the North Pole to deliver a gift to Santa Claus.

videos.title: Super Map
videos.overview: Map finds a magic cape that gives him superpowers. Now, using his new superpowers, Map must lead Dora and Boots to Dora's house so her father can show her a surprise.

videos.title: Lost Map
videos.overview: A silly bird mistakes Map for a stick and it's up to Boots and Dora to rescue their friend.

videos.title: Dora, La Música
videos.overview: Dora and Boots lead a parade to free musical instruments that were locked up by Senor Shush, who doesn't allow music in his village.

videos.title: The Lost City
videos.overview: Dora and Boots travel to the Lost City, where they hope to find Dora's lost teddy bear, Osito, and nearly everyone else's favorite things.

videos.title: Egg Hunt
videos.overview: Today is Easter and Dora and Boots hunt for cascarones – Easter eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

videos.title: To the Monkey Bars
videos.overview: Dora has a secret; she never conquered the monkey bars. If she wants to retry it, she and Boots need to race over to the playground.

videos.title: Hide and Go Seek
videos.overview: Dora plays a competetive game of hide and seek with her friends in order to win a trophy.

videos.title: School Pet
videos.overview: Dora and Boots search for Mimo, the school's hamster, when he goes missing.

videos.title: Quack! Quack!
videos.overview: Dora and Boots save a baby duckling that has magically come to life in their coloring book.

videos.title: León, the Circus Lion
videos.overview: Dora and Boots help Leon the Lion, who has an unusual talent of juggling and unicycling, to join the circus.

videos.title: Star Catcher
videos.overview: Dora receives a Star Pocket from her Abuela and learns to catch stars.

videos.title: Stuck Truck
videos.overview: One day in Boots' Room (Tree House), Boots is showing Dora all his trucks (10 Wheeler, Giant Crane, Bulldozer, Rojo (Fire Truck), Tow Truck and Ice Cream Truck). Boots receives a disdress call and discovers that Ice Cream Truck is in trouble, Boots calls for all of the trucks to help Ice Cream Truck near Play Park. Dora and Boots sets off to save Ice Cream Truck by going over Puzzle Bridge, across Crocodile Lake and to Play Park.

videos.title: Roberto the Robot
videos.overview: Dora and Boots came across with an in-active Robot, after activating it with 8 batteries they discovered that he is lost Robot named Roberto. Dora and Boots helps Roberto the Robot get back home to his grandpa (his creator) by going over The Railroad Bridge, through the Volcano and to Grandpa's House.

videos.title: ¡Por Favor!
videos.overview: Dora reads Boots the Fairy Tale story about a young king named King Kaju, as she reads the story they discovers that King Kaju cannot be crowned because he needs to say "Por Favor" ("Please" in english) for the crown to come down. Dora and Boots enters the book to tell King Kaju the magic words "Por Favor" by going through the Dragon's Forest, over the Draw Bridge and to the Castle.

videos.title: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue
videos.overview: Dora and Boots needs to rescue 3 friends. However, Boots, Baby Jaguar, and Isa freak out when they see something dangerous, so Dora teaches them to take deep breaths to calm down.

videos.title: Save the Puppies!
videos.overview: Dora and Boots jump into a handheld console video game to protect 100 puppies from being locked up by a mean dog catcher.

videos.title: The Big Potato
videos.overview: Benny accidentally turns himself into a potato, using a magic wand from a friendly young wizard. Now Dora, Boots and Benny must get to the wizard's castle to reverse the spell.

videos.title: What Happens Next?
videos.overview: Dora and Boots read the story about the 3 Little Pigs, when the story ended Boots asked what happens next. Dora thought of using their imaginations to make something up for the story to go on, in their version of the story they volunteered to help the King see his mommy again. Dora and Boots had to find the King's mommy by going through The 3 Bear's House, passed The Beanstalk and to The Rainbow.

videos.title: The Fix-It Machine
videos.overview: Boots has a hole on his boot, Dora suggests that they go to the Super Duper Fix It Machine, with a squink and a boink and a ricekty pop it will take anything and fix it right up. On their way to the Super Duper Fix It Machine, they meet up with their friends also have holes in their things. Dora, Boots and their friends went all together through Crocodile Lake, over the Troll Bridge and to The Fix It Machine.

videos.title: Meet Diego!
videos.overview: Dora introduces her cousin, Diego, to the viewers for the first time. For their first mission together, Dora, Boots and Diego must save a baby jaguar from a waterfall.

videos.title: Baby Dino
videos.overview: Dora, Boots, and Diego help a baby dinosaur to return home with his mom at Dino Island.

videos.title: Baseball Boots
videos.overview: Boots wants to have his first big hit, so he and Dora go to the baseball stadium to see if it can be done.

videos.title: Boots' Special Day
videos.overview: It is someone's special day and according to the Fiesta Trio, it is Boots' special day. On someone's special day, he or she could do anything they want and they could wear the special day crown. Dora goes with Boots as he plans to lead the Parade at The Big Drum Parade, pet the animals at The Animal Center and to see his Daddy at The Amusement Park.

videos.title: Boo!
videos.overview: On Halloween night, Dora and Boots meet Little Monster and travel with him to the Monster House for a Halloween party before midnight.

videos.title: Dora Saves the Game
videos.overview: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing a soccer game. But when Daisy's team, the Yellow Tigers, has one player less, Daisy counts on Dora to play on her team.

videos.title: The Super Silly Fiesta
videos.overview: Today, the Big Red Chicken is hosting a Super Silly Fiesta. But the cake is gone!

videos.title: Boots' Cuddly Dinosaur
videos.overview: Boots needs to find his cuddly dinosaur in time for a sleepover at Dora's house before sunset.

videos.title: Job Day
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are wondering what they want to be when they grow up.

videos.title: Louder!
videos.overview: Dora and Boots help soothe Red Rooster's throat and together, they set off to the Highest Hill to wake up the sun.

videos.title: ABC Animals
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are with the Giant ABC Book, when the book opened the Armadillo came out asking for help. According to Armadillo, all of this animal friends inside the Giant ABC Book are missing and now he is all alone. Dora and Boots helps Armadillo find all of his animal friends by going through The Elevator at E, through The Slippery Slide at S and to Z.

videos.title: Whose Birthday Is It?
videos.overview: Dora and Boots join a birthday party at Play Park.

videos.title: Dora's Fairytale Adventure
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are playing in a magical place where fairy tale characters live: Fairy Tale Land! But when a mean witch casts a spell on Boots, he falls into a deep, deep sleep. The only way to break the spell is for Sleeping Boots to get a hug from a true princess. Can Dora become a princess and save Boots?

videos.title: Daisy, La Quinceañera
videos.overview: Today is Daisy's (Diego's Sister) La Fiesta de Quinceniera (15th Birthday). As Dora and Boots practice the Mambo dance, they receive a call from Daisy saying that she needs her Crown and Shoes for the party. The party cannot start without the celebrant's crown and shoes, so Dora and Boots had to hurry to give Daisy her special birthday present. Dora and Boots takes the fastest way to the party by going through the Barn, through the Rain Forest and to Daisy's party.

videos.title: Dora's Pirate Adventure
videos.overview: Dora and her friends are about to put on a play about pirates for an audience of friends and relatives. When the Pirate Piggies steal the treasure chest with costumes inside, the group sets out to cross what's literally the Seven Seas and pass under the Singing Bridge to get to Treasure Island and get the costumes back in time for the show.

videos.title: Big Sister Dora
videos.overview: Dora just got a new puppy named Perito, after Dora and Boots picked up a present for Perito from Abuela (Dora's Grandma), they have been warned to watch out for Swiper the Fox. Dora and Boots had to hurry home to take the present home to Perito, before Swiper swipes it. Dora and Boots hurries home and avoids Swiper by going through the Butterfly Garden, through the 10 Dancing Trees, and to Dora's House.

videos.title: Super Babies
videos.overview: Botass está cantando a música de Dora, que também passou a ser seu dever de casa para a escola, Dora chama Botas dizendo que ela deixou a música na casa de Botas. Dora pede a Botas para levar sua canção para a escola quando ele for lá, mas ele tem que se apressar porque a aula está prestes a começar. Botas corre para a escola com a música de Dora passando pelo Selva do Alto e Baixo, através da Casa do Robô e para a escola.

videos.title: Catch the Babies
videos.overview: Dora deve evitar que o carrinho de seus irmãos role para o Geyser  Pegajoso.

videos.title: Dora's Got A Puppy
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are helping King Juan el Bobo to prepare for his Mommy's birthday party.

videos.title: Dora and Diego to the Rescue
videos.overview: Dora and her cousin Diego are on off on a high-speed, around-the-world adventure to save Boots the monkey! Boots has been carried away on his giant kite by a mighty wind, and now Dora and Diego are chasing after him. They'll need YOUR help as they cross the Ocean atop a whale, swing through trees with singing gorillas, run across the Tall Grass with giraffes, zebras, elephants, hippos, and lions, and finally reach Polar Bear Mountain. There, they find Boots and his kite stuck atop a tree...with a polar bear circling beneath it.  Luckily, Diego has his Rescue Pack that can transform into anything they need! Rescue Pack transforms into a rocket sled and Diego and Dora blast off to catch Boots. But will they save him in time?

videos.title: A Crown For King Juan el Bobo
videos.overview: Dora e Botas estão no Centro de Animais de Diego para uma visita.

videos.title: Dora Had a Little Lamb
videos.overview: Dora and Boots jump into a book of nursery rhymes in order to return a lost lamb to her friend Mary.

videos.title: Mixed-Up Seasons
videos.overview: Dora and Boots go through all the different seasons to get the pumpkin, flower, snowman and crab back to the right seasont they belong in.

videos.title: Best Friends
videos.overview: Dora and Boots plan to meet each other at Rainbow Rock to have a Best Friend's Day picnic.

videos.title: Journey to the Purple Planet
videos.overview: Dora and Boots blast off into outer space to help 5 aliens named Flinky, Inky, Pinky, Dinky, and Al get back to the Purple Planet.

videos.title: Dora's Dance to the Rescue
videos.overview: After getting tricked by a dance-loving elf, Swiper gets trapped in his magic bottle and it's up to Dora and Boots to win a dance competition at the castle! The prize is one big wish, and they have to wish Swiper free from the bottle.

videos.title: To the South Pole
videos.overview: Dora, Boots, and Diego help a baby penguin get back to the South Pole.

videos.title: Dora's First Trip
videos.overview: One night in Dora's house, Dora with her family and friends are having dinner. Dora tells the story about how she first met Boots, it was the during the first time she ever went out exploring. As Dora the Boots go exploring they met the others on the way (Tico, Isa, Benny), when they met the Fiesta Trio who were on their way to perform for the Queen Bee. As they leave they dropped their instruments. Dora and Boots helps take the instruments back to the Fiesta Trio by going through the Nutty Forest, across the Big River and up the Tallest Mountain.

videos.title: Baby Jaguar's Roar
videos.overview: It is a very busy day for Diego saving animals one after another, until he got caught into trouble himself while saving a baby bird. When Dora hears about this, she and Boots sets off to save Diego. Dora and Boots hurry to save Diego by going across "El Rio Rapido" (The Fast River), down the Super Big Mud Slide, and up to Rocky Mountain before he falls into the prickers and thorns.

videos.title: Boots to the Rescue
videos.overview: Dora's mami is having a baby and Dora is eagerly awaiting the new arrival...she just can't wait to be a big sister! But when Dora arrives to see the new baby, there's a big surprise waiting for her...Twins! Now Dora has a baby brother and a baby sister!

videos.title: Dora's World Adventure
videos.overview: Dora and her friends are excited to celebrate Friendship Day. Soon, they run into a problem when they realize that Swiper has stolen all of the friendship bracelets from around the world. The bracelets won't glow unless everyone from each country wears them, so Dora offers to help Swiper give them back. Along the way, they meet some of Dora's friends in France, Tanzania, Russia, and China.

videos.title: Star Mountain
videos.overview: One night in Dora's house, Dora with her family and friends are having dinner. Dora tells the story about how she first met Boots, it was the during the first time she ever went out exploring. As Dora the Boots go exploring they met the others on the way (Tico, Isa, Benny), when they met the Fiesta Trio who were on their way to perform for the Queen Bee. As they leave they dropped their instruments. Dora and Boots helps take the instruments back to the Fiesta Trio by going through the Nutty Forest, across the Big River and up the Tallest Mountain.

videos.title: Baby Crab
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are playing in the beach, there they hear a call for help from a Baby Crab that is caught in a net. After freeing the Baby Crab and cheering him up, they discover that Baby Crab is lost and is far away from him. Dora and Boots helps Baby Crab get home to his mommy by going through the Sand Castle, through the Snapping Clams and to Crab Island.

videos.title: La Maestra de Musica (The Music Teacher)
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are going to school, on their way they heard someone singing Boots' favorite song. Following the song they discovered it was coming from a lady on a bike, it was Boots' "La Maestra Musica" (Boots' Music Teacher). Boots introduces Dora to his Music Teacher, when they heard the school bell La Maestra had to get to school before all the students does. When La Maestra's bike chain broke down, Dora and Boots helps La Maestra by going through the Town, over Musical Mountain and to the School.

videos.title: Dora Saves the Mermaids
videos.overview: Dora and Boots set out to help Mariana the mermaid recover the magic crown to wish the Mermaid Kingdom to be clean again, and to stop an evil octopus from dumping garbage all over.

videos.title: Super Spies
videos.overview: Dora and Boots need to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes by using spy goggles, rocket boots and a spy rope.

videos.title: The Shy Rainbow
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are on Rainbow Rock to watch the Rainbows, there they came across a shy little Rainbow (Arco Iris) hiding behind a little waterfalls. The Sun now needs another rainbow fast, Dora and Boots helps Arco Iris overcome his shyness by encouraging him. Dora, Boots and Arco Iris sets off to help the Sun by going over the Troll Bridge, across Sneezing Snake Lake and to Rainy Mountain.

videos.title: Super Spies 2: The Swiping Machine
videos.overview: Dora just got a present from her Abuela (Grandma), it is a necklace matching her bracelet. When Swiper swiped it and threw it away, all the way up to Star Mountain. According to Dora, Star Mountain is home to all of the Explorer Stars, so she decides to call for the Stars for their help. Dora and Boots goes to get the necklace back by going up The 15 steps, climb up the Diamond and up the Giant Star.

videos.title: We're a Team
videos.overview: The Super Adventure Race is here, and Dora, Boots, and the gang need the maps help to make it to the finish line.

videos.title: The Backpack Parade
videos.overview: Dora, Luis and the Backpack are on their way to a parade until Backpack sneezes because of her allergies and drops all the contents of her Backpack.

videos.title: Benny's Big Race
videos.overview: Dora, Botas e Diego estão todos prontos para a festa dos Três Reis! Mas Raposo assustou todos os animais! Será que eles vão conseguir a tempo?

videos.title: Isa's Unicorn Flowers
videos.overview: Dora and Isa help a baby unicorn get back to the unicorn's forest after he gets lost when his magical rainbow disappears.

videos.title: Dora's Jack-in-the-Box
videos.overview: Help the Big Red Chicken perform his magic show!

videos.title: Dora Saves the Snow Princess
videos.overview: Sabrina the snow princess has had her magic crystal stolen by an evil witch who has locked her away in a tower in hopes that all the snow in the forest will melt. Dora, Boots, and the Snowflake Fairy set out to rescue the snow princess and prevent the snow from melting.

videos.title: The Mayan Adventure
videos.overview: Dora and Boots jump into a story to help the twins win the Mayan ball game!

videos.title: Bouncy Boots
videos.overview: Boots makes a wish on a Wishing Machine to make bananas fall on him whenever he says "bananas"... but the wish isn't turning out so good!

videos.title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show
videos.overview: Help the Big Red Chicken perform his magic show!

videos.title: Benny's Treasure
videos.overview: Swiper swipes the Three Little Piggies' bricks... now the story can't end right! It's up to Dora, Boots and Swiper to save the story!

videos.title: Dora Saves Three Kings Day
videos.overview: Dora, Botas e Diego estão todos prontos para a festa dos Três Reis! Mas Raposo assustou todos os animais! Será que eles vão conseguir a tempo?

videos.title: Save Diego
videos.overview: Diego has saved many animals, but now he's the one who needs to be saved because he ended up on a cliff when rescuing a parrot. If he falls off the cliff, he will get punctured by a large pile of cacti. Dora and Boots must rescue him before it's too late.

videos.title: Dora Saves the Three Lil' Piggies
videos.overview: Swiper swipes the Three Little Piggies' bricks... now the story can't end right! It's up to Dora, Boots and Swiper to save the story!

videos.title: Bark, Bark to Play Park
videos.overview: It's Twins Day, and Dora and Boots are off to Play Park to reunite Dora's puppy, Perrito, with his twin brother.

videos.title: Dora Saves the Crystal Kingdom
videos.overview: Dora and Boots must help a girl save her kingdom when it's drained of color with the help of the Snow Princess.

videos.title: Dora's Christmas Carol Adventure
videos.overview: Santa Claus narrates the story of when Swiper tried to swipe the star off the Christmas tree at Dora's Nochebuena party. He then finds himself on Santa's naughty list. When Dora tries to ask Santa if there's any way to take Swiper off the naughty list, Santa says the only way is that if Swiper learns the true meaning of Christmas.

videos.title: Swiper the Explorer
videos.overview: Swiper reveals his good side when he travels with Dora and Boots and helps them to return a baby fox to its mother.

videos.title: Super Babies Dream Adventure
videos.overview: When the Super Babies have a nap, Dora and Boots travel to the Dream Castle.

videos.title: Pirate Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are looking for a lost treasure with their friends the Lil' Piggies.

videos.title: Dora's Big Birthday Adventure
videos.overview: Dora and Boots need to get back home before Dora's birthday party starts.

videos.title: First Day of School
videos.overview: Boots and Tico are off to their first day of school. Let's learn Spanish along the way.

videos.title: Boots' Banana Wish
videos.overview: A wish machine makes bananas drop on Boots' head--endlessly.

videos.title: Dora's Pegaso Adventure
videos.overview: Dora and her friends must find all the constellations after a meteor shower scares them away.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, Super Babies!
videos.overview: The Super Babies must team up with Dora and Boots to save birthday cakes from the cake-snatching bear.

videos.title: Dora's Hair-Raising Adventure
videos.overview: Dora takes Boots to a barber shop to get a haircut.

videos.title: Baby Winky Comes Home
videos.overview: Dora and Boots must help Baby Winky get back to his family's spaceship before it returns to the purple planet.

videos.title: Dora Helps the Birthday Wizzle
videos.overview: Dora and Boots rescue a special wishing wand for the Birthday Wizzle.

videos.title: The Grumpy Old Troll Gets Married
videos.overview: The Grumpy Old Troll is getting married to his girlfriend, Petunia. But he forgot to pick up the wedding rings from his grandmother's house! Now, it's up to Dora, Boots and the Troll to find the rings before the wedding starts.

videos.title: Dora's Ballet Adventure
videos.overview: As Dora is preparing for a dance recital, the Delivery Duck brings her scuba flippers instead of ballet slippers. Now, Dora and Boots must find the slippers before the recital begins. Along the way, Dora teaches her friends how to dance during a small situation to show that dancing can make you feel good.

videos.title: Boots' First Bike
videos.overview: It's a big day of firsts when Boots gets his first bike from the bike shop.

videos.title: ¡Vacaciones! (Vacations!)
videos.overview: With their snacks, flashlight, and binoculars packed, Dora and Boots are off to a camping trip with Diego and Baby Jaguar.

videos.title: Pepe's School Day Adventure
videos.overview: Dora tries to help Pepe the Pig win a popcorn party at school.

videos.title: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures (1): Tale of the Unicorn King
videos.overview: Unicornio has been chosen to be king of the forest, so Dora and Boots help him get to his castle.

videos.title: Halloween Parade
videos.overview: Dora and Boots must help Little Monster find a costume so he can march in the Halloween parade.

videos.title: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures (3): Dora Saves King Unicornio
videos.overview: The Enchanted Forest is in grave peril as the owl usurped Unicornio's position as king and trapped Unicornio. Dora and Boots must venture into the forest to rescue Unicornio and teach the owl a lesson.

videos.title: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures (2): The Secret of Atlantis
videos.overview: Dora, Boots, Diego, and King Unicornio leave the Enchanted Forest to end an ancient feud between the unicorns and the dragons, and to save the lost continent of Atlantis. Meanwhile, a greedy owl is given the opportunity to act as king and watch over the forest.

videos.title: The Big Red Chicken’s Magic Wand
videos.overview: The Big Red Chicken is doing magic tricks and for his first trick, he turns Boots into a chicken. When he tries to turn him back into a monkey, he lets out a big sneeze that propels the magic wand into Magic Land. Dora and friends set off on a magic-filled journey in order to get the wand fixed so Boots can become a monkey again.

videos.title: Swiper's Favorite Things
videos.overview: Swiper is packing all of his favorite things for a sleepover at his Grandma’s House — his pajama trunk, his favorite puppy book, and his very special funny bunny. Just as he is about to leave, a big wind gust comes in and blows everything away! Dora and Swiper journey to Crocodile Lake, through the Jumbled Trees, and race to Strawberry Hill to get Swiper’s favorite things back

videos.title: A Ribbon for Pinto
videos.overview: Dora, Boots and Pinto are heading to the big horse show, but the train breaks down on the way.

videos.title: Dora's Knighthood Adventure
videos.overview: Boots loves to hear stories about knights who go on heroic adventures and Don Quixote (Andy Garcia) tells Dora and Boots that anyone can be a knight as long as they help others. Boots would love to be a knight and so would his friends Rocinante the horse and Dapple the donkey, but they need someone to rescue. Dora takes out her spotting scope and they discover a princess calling out for help from the Royal Garden. Dora, Boots, Rocinante and Dapple set out through the Puppet Stage, past Tico’s Carousel to get to the Royal Garden and save the princess.

videos.title: Dora's Rescue in Mermaid Kingdom
videos.overview: Dora and Boots turn into sea creatures to help a lost mermaid return to her mother.

videos.title: Dora's Easter Adventure
videos.overview: Swiper’s up to no good again and Dora, Boots and their new friend the Hip-Hop Bunny must stop him.

videos.title: Dora in Troll Land
videos.overview: Dora and her friends explore Troll Land, a secret place where the Grumpy Old Troll lives. In this kind of dimension, everything rhymes.

videos.title: ¡Feliz Dia de los Padres! (Father's Day)
videos.overview: Dora makes a kite for her Papi on Father's Day, and must retrieve it when it gets blown away.

videos.title: Dora's Fantastic Gymnastics Adventure
videos.overview: Dora and Boots are practicing for the Fantastic Gymnastics Show when Dora gets a special delivery: a beautiful rainbow ribbon. But Swiper came and swiped the ribbon so the duo must get it back in time for the show.

videos.title: School Science Fair
videos.overview: Dora and Emma are bringing a project volcano to the Green Power Science Fair with new friends.

videos.title: Dora's Moonlight Adventure
videos.overview: Dora takes care of some kittens for Abuela, but they go missing.

videos.title: Perrito's Big Surprise
videos.overview: There's a surprise waiting for Perrito, but Swiper wants to swipe the present! Will Dora be able to prevent Swiper from doing so at Surprise Hill?

videos.title: Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus
videos.overview: Boots and Baby Jaguar are having an animal circus, and Dora and Diego rush to get there.

videos.title: Benny the Castaway
videos.overview: Benny gets stranded on the crazy, deserted Coconut Island, and it's up to Dora and Boots to save him.

videos.title: Baby Bongo's Big Music Show
videos.overview: Dora and Boots take Baby Bongo on a musical adventure as they race to the Big Music Show in time for Baby Bongo's first performance.

videos.title: Dora's Royal Rescue
videos.overview: Dora and Boots become a lady knight and a squire, and assist a noble horse in saving Don Quixote, who's been captured by an evil wizard and is being held in an abandoned library.

videos.title: Dora's Thanksgiving Day Parade
videos.overview: Dora and Boots rush to get Dora's float back for the Thanksgiving Day parade when the Pirate Piggies cause it to fly away.

videos.title: Book Explorers
videos.overview: Dora and Boots visit the library, where they jump into books, meet characters of books, and help them find their lost items.

videos.title: Check Up Day
videos.overview: Dora is at the doctor's office for her yearly check up. There, she meets a few animals who are sick and learns that getting a shot isn't as bad as it looks.

videos.title: Little Map
videos.overview: Map shows his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures and make a treasure map. Soon, Dora and Boots go on a treasure hunt of their own.

videos.title: Vamos a Pintar! (Let's Paint!)
videos.overview: Dora and Boots have to bring their special paintbrush to help their painter friend at the art studio.

videos.title: Dora Rocks!
videos.overview: Dora and Boots have to get to Benny's barn so they can use Dora's microphone to invite their friends over for a sing-along party.

videos.title: The Butterfly Ball
videos.overview: Dora and Boots must help their butterfly friend, Mariposa, attend the Butterfly Ball, where everyone gets their special set of wings.

videos.title: Dora and Perrito to the Rescue
videos.overview: Dora and her dog rush to the Big River to save Boots.

videos.title: Puppies Galore
videos.overview: Dora and her pals accompany a bunch of puppies to rescue a young dog named Little Boots.

videos.title: Catch That Shape Train
videos.overview: Dora and Boots make a train out of shapes in Boots' sticker book, and they jump in to retrieve the forgotten steering wheel before the train heads for the final turn on the tracks.

videos.title: Kittens in Mittens
videos.overview: Dora reads "The Three Little Kittens" to Abuela's new cat, Lucky, and jumps into the book of nursery rhymes to help the kittens find their mittens.

videos.title: Dora's Great Roller Skate Adventure
videos.overview: Dora and Boots put on their roller skates and take off on a skating adventure to open Skate Park for everyone.

videos.title: Verde's Birthday Party!
videos.overview: Dora, Boots, and Verde the Clean-Up Truck must clear up a flood at Party Park in time for Verde's birthday party.

videos.title: Dora's and Sparky's Riding Adventure!
videos.overview: Dora helps Sparky the Horse feel better, and then takes him for a ride before returning him to the barn.

videos.title: Dora's Rainforest Talent Show
videos.overview: Dora and Boots put on their roller skates and take off on a skating adventure to open Skate Park for everyone.

videos.title: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs
videos.overview: Dora and Diego travel back to prehistoric times and go on a dinosaur adventure.

videos.title: Dora's Ice Skating Spectacular
videos.overview: Dora and Boots must help the Snow Princess defeat the Ice Witch in a skating contest in order to win back everyone's skates.

videos.title: Riding the Roller Coaster Rocks
videos.overview: Dora, Boots and Abuela search for the secret door to an amusement park.

videos.title: Dora in Wonderland
videos.overview: When Dora's kittens run through a magic mirror, Dora and Boots end up in Wonderland.

videos.title: Dora’s Museum Sleepover Adventure
videos.overview: Dora brings a magic cape to the prince's castle to break a spell.

videos.title: Dora's Super Soccer Showdown
videos.overview: Dora travels to Brazil to play in the Big Cup Soccer Tournament against a team of soccer-playing monsters.

videos.title: Dora Saves Fairytale Land
videos.overview: Dora and Boots journey into the Never-to-be-Seen-Again Forest, so they can bring water back from Sparkling Lake and save the magic in Fairytale Land.

videos.title: Dora and the Very Sleepy Bear
videos.overview: Dora and Boots try to keep a very sleepy Baby Bear awake long enough to get her home for her winter nap.

videos.title: Let's Go to Music School
videos.overview: Dora, Emma and Kate help Gus the Bus take all of the instruments to the kids at Music School.
